dog.description_text:
Hi, I'm Stubbin, and I'm a handsome tan-and-white pup who's only 6 months young! I'm already neutered, and at about 18 pounds I'm a medium-sized mixed breed with a bicolor coat that really stands out. I have medium energy and I'm good with kids, so I can be a great fit for a family with little ones. Adventurous, affectionate, and loyal, I'm ready to share my playful side with my new people 🐾. My adoption fee is $185, so come meet me today and let's start our adventure together! 🐶
This animal is located at our Westhampton Adoption Center, head in to meet them and see if you are a match! We are a same-day adoption center, and an application does not put you on a list or hold an animal for you. We are open Tuesday-Sunday 11am-4pm. Prior to adoption, all of our animals are spayed/neutered, microchipped, and given their age appropriate shots. Apply for Adoption Today!
